cards.explanation: Barb means a backward-pointing spike on a fish hook, and also a swift horse of a breed from North Africa. Barb the horse is the Barbary breed, ancestor of some thoroughbreds.

rounds.title: Master pairs 9

clues: To remain in place
A rope that holds a mast steady
cards.example: Please ____ where you are.
cards.explanation: Stay means to remain in place, and also a rope that holds a mast steady. A stay is a supporting rope; in the plural, an old word for a corset.

clues: The part of the leg between knee and ankle
The shaft of an anchor or a key
cards.example: He injured his ____ in the tackle.
cards.explanation: Shank means the part of the leg between knee and ankle, and also the shaft of an anchor or a key. Shank is the shin, a shaft, or in golf a mishit.

clues: A British county
A very large breed of draught horse
cards.example: The old ____ boundary ran along the river.
cards.explanation: Shire means a British county, and also a very large breed of draught horse. Shire horses were the heavy draught breed of the English midlands.

clues: A drink made from fermented honey
A meadow, in poetry
cards.example: They drank ____ from horn cups.
cards.explanation: Mead means a drink made from fermented honey, and also a meadow, in poetry. Mead the drink is ancient; mead as meadow is poetic.

clues: A musical note lasting half a semibreve
The smallest liquid measure used by apothecaries
cards.example: Hold the ____ for two beats.
cards.explanation: Minim means a musical note lasting half a semibreve, and also the smallest liquid measure used by apothecaries. A minim is also about one drop, 1/60 of a fluid drachm.

rounds.title: Master pairs 10

clues: To play music or perform in the street for money
A stiffening strip of whalebone in a corset
cards.example: She likes to ____ outside the station.
cards.explanation: Busk means to play music or perform in the street for money, and also a stiffening strip of whalebone in a corset. Busk the verb is to perform in the street; busk the noun is a corset stiffener.

clues: To remove a ruler from power
To give evidence under oath in writing
cards.example: The army moved to ____ the king.
cards.explanation: Depose means to remove a ruler from power, and also to give evidence under oath in writing. In law, to depose is to testify on oath, usually in a written statement.

clues: To carry something heavy
Short for the totalisator, a system of pooled betting
cards.example: She had to ____ the shopping home.
cards.explanation: Tote means to carry something heavy, and also short for the totalisator, a system of pooled betting. The tote is the totalisator, a pooled betting system.

clues: A shady leafy shelter in a garden
A heavy anchor carried at a ship's bow
cards.example: They sat in a rose ____.
cards.explanation: Bower means a shady leafy shelter in a garden, and also a heavy anchor carried at a ship's bow. Bower anchors are the pair of heavy anchors carried in a ship's bow.

clues: A book recording accounts
A flat stone slab laid over a grave
cards.example: The clerk entered the sum in the ____.
cards.explanation: Ledger means a book recording accounts, and also a flat stone slab laid over a grave. A ledger stone is a flat slab covering a grave.

rounds.title: Master pairs 11

clues: A knitting stitch
To flow with a soft murmuring sound, as a brook
cards.example: Knit one, ____ one.
cards.explanation: Purl means a knitting stitch, and also to flow with a soft murmuring sound, as a brook. Purl the verb is poetic for a gentle babbling of water.

clues: State of health or condition, as in 'in fine ...'
To trim rough edges from a casting
cards.example: She was in fine ____ after her holiday.
cards.explanation: Fettle means state of health or condition, as in 'in fine ...', and also to trim rough edges from a casting. To fettle is also to fix or tinker, from Lancashire dialect.

clues: The edible seed within a nut's shell
The core part of a computer's operating system
cards.example: Crack the shell to reach the ____.
cards.explanation: Kernel means the edible seed within a nut's shell, and also the core part of a computer's operating system. A kernel is the seed inside a nut and the heart of an operating system.

clues: A lake
Nothing more than
cards.example: Rydal is a small ____ in the Lake District.
cards.explanation: Mere means a lake, and also nothing more than. Mere meaning a lake survives in place names such as Windermere.

clues: A wild expanse of heather upland
To tie up a boat
cards.example: The ____ was purple with heather.
cards.explanation: Moor means a wild expanse of heather upland, and also to tie up a boat. To moor is to secure a vessel; a moor is open heath.

rounds.title: Master pairs 12

clues: A continuous flow or state of change
A substance used to help metals join when soldering
cards.example: Her plans were in a state of ____.
cards.explanation: Flux means a continuous flow or state of change, and also a substance used to help metals join when soldering. Flux is both change and the cleaning agent in soldering.

clues: A mouthful of strong drink swallowed quickly
A garden mollusc with no shell
cards.example: He took a ____ of whisky.
cards.explanation: Slug means a mouthful of strong drink swallowed quickly, and also a garden mollusc with no shell. Slug is a gulp of spirits, a shell-less mollusc, and a bullet.

clues: Chief or principal
The open sea, in poetry
cards.example: The ____ road was blocked.
cards.explanation: Main means chief or principal, and also the open sea, in poetry. The Spanish Main and 'the main' are poetic names for the open sea.

clues: A small swivelling wheel on a piece of furniture
A shaker with a perforated top for sprinkling sugar
cards.example: The sofa has a ____ on each leg.
cards.explanation: Caster means a small swivelling wheel on a piece of furniture, and also a shaker with a perforated top for sprinkling sugar. Caster and castor are both accepted; both senses use either spelling.

clues: To bend out of shape
The set of lengthwise threads on a loom
cards.example: Damp will ____ the door.
cards.explanation: Warp means to bend out of shape, and also the set of lengthwise threads on a loom. The warp threads run lengthways; to warp is to twist out of shape.

rounds.title: Expert pairs 13

clues: The woolly coat of a sheep
To swindle someone out of money
cards.example: The shearer removed the ____ in one piece.
cards.explanation: Fleece means the woolly coat of a sheep, and also to swindle someone out of money. Fleece is a sheep's wool and also slang for swindling.

clues: The actors in a production
A rigid plaster support for a broken limb
cards.example: The whole ____ took a bow.
cards.explanation: Cast means the actors in a production, and also a rigid plaster support for a broken limb. A cast is a company of actors and a plaster for a fracture.

clues: A position in a hierarchy
Foul-smelling and offensive
cards.example: She rose quickly through the ____.
cards.explanation: Rank means a position in a hierarchy, and also foul-smelling and offensive. Rank is a position and, as an adjective, a strong, offensive smell.

clues: A sharp pointed piece of metal
To secretly add alcohol to a drink
cards.example: Someone had put a ____ in the punch.
cards.explanation: Spike means a sharp pointed piece of metal, and also to secretly add alcohol to a drink. To spike a drink is to lace it with extra spirits.

clues: A structure carrying a road over a river
A card game for four players
cards.example: They played ____ every Tuesday.
cards.explanation: Bridge means a structure carrying a road over a river, and also a card game for four players. Bridge is both a crossing and a card game.

clues: A furry fungal growth on old food
A hollow shape used to set a jelly
cards.example: There was ____ on the bread.
cards.explanation: Mould means a furry fungal growth on old food, and also a hollow shape used to set a jelly. A mould is a fungus and a form for shaping food.

clues: Severe and strict
The back end of a ship
cards.example: The headmistress gave a ____ look.
cards.explanation: Stern means severe and strict, and also the back end of a ship. Stern describes strictness and the rear of a boat.

clues: To unravel at the edges
A noisy fight or brawl
cards.example: The old rope began to ____.
cards.explanation: Fray means to unravel at the edges, and also a noisy fight or brawl. A fray is a scrap, and to fray is to wear into loose threads.

clues: Tied up with rope
A spring or jump
cards.example: The prisoner was ____ hand and foot.
cards.explanation: Bound means tied up with rope, and also a spring or jump. Bound can mean tied, destined, or a leap.

clues: A long exchange of shots in tennis
A mass public meeting in support of a cause
cards.example: The ____ lasted forty shots.
cards.explanation: Rally means a long exchange of shots in tennis, and also a mass public meeting in support of a cause. A rally is a tennis exchange and a gathering of supporters.

rounds.title: Expert pairs 15

clues: Cord thinner than rope
The violins, violas and cellos of an orchestra
cards.example: He tied the parcel with ____.
cards.explanation: String means cord thinner than rope, and also the violins, violas and cellos of an orchestra. String is thin cord and the bowed section of an orchestra.

clues: The track of disturbed water behind a ship
A watch kept beside a dead person before burial
cards.example: The boat left a white ____.
cards.explanation: Wake means the track of disturbed water behind a ship, and also a watch kept beside a dead person before burial. A wake is a ship's trail and a vigil for the dead.

clues: A small house at the entrance to an estate
To become firmly stuck
cards.example: The gatekeeper lived in the ____.
cards.explanation: Lodge means a small house at the entrance to an estate, and also to become firmly stuck. To lodge is to stick fast, and a lodge is a gatehouse.

clues: A tool with bristles
A fox's bushy tail
cards.example: She gave her hair a quick ____.
cards.explanation: Brush means a tool with bristles, and also a fox's bushy tail. A fox's tail is called its brush.

clues: The end of a sleeve
To strike lightly with the open hand
cards.example: A button on his shirt ____ had come loose.
cards.explanation: Cuff means the end of a sleeve, and also to strike lightly with the open hand. A cuff is part of a sleeve and a light blow.

rounds.title: Expert pairs 16

clues: To deduct money from someone's pay
A harbour area where ships load
cards.example: The boss threatened to ____ his wages.
cards.explanation: Dock means to deduct money from someone's pay, and also a harbour area where ships load. To dock is to cut off or reduce, and a dock is a ship berth.

clues: To emerge from an egg
An opening in a ship's deck or a wall
cards.example: The chicks began to ____ at dawn.
cards.explanation: Hatch means to emerge from an egg, and also an opening in a ship's deck or a wall. A hatch is an opening, and to hatch is to emerge from the egg.

clues: A person who entertains guests
A great number of things
cards.example: The ____ welcomed everyone at the door.
cards.explanation: Host means a person who entertains guests, and also a great number of things. A host is also a multitude, as in a host of daffodils.

clues: A part of the body with a specific function
A keyboard instrument with pipes
cards.example: The liver is a vital ____.
cards.explanation: Organ means a part of the body with a specific function, and also a keyboard instrument with pipes. An organ is a body part and a pipe instrument.

clues: To choose from a selection
A pointed tool for breaking rock
cards.example: You can ____ any one you like.
cards.explanation: Pick means to choose from a selection, and also a pointed tool for breaking rock. A pick is a choice and a miner's tool.

rounds.title: Expert pairs 17

clues: A grass-like plant that grows in marshes
A sudden hurry
cards.example: Reeds and ____ grew along the bank.
cards.explanation: Rush means a grass-like plant that grows in marshes, and also a sudden hurry. A rush is a marsh plant and a hurry.

clues: A grey-green herb used in stuffing
A wise person
cards.example: Roast pork is often served with ____ stuffing.
cards.explanation: Sage means a grey-green herb used in stuffing, and also a wise person. A sage is a wise elder and a culinary herb.

clues: Clever and quick-witted
To sting with sharp pain
cards.example: The cut began to ____ in the salt water.
cards.explanation: Smart means clever and quick-witted, and also to sting with sharp pain. Smart means intelligent and, as a verb, to sting.

clues: A fastener for paper
A main food in a region's diet
cards.example: She used a ____ to join the pages.
cards.explanation: Staple means a fastener for paper, and also a main food in a region's diet. A staple holds papers and rice is a staple food.

clues: A breed or variety
To pour through a sieve
cards.example: This ____ of wheat resists drought.
cards.explanation: Strain means a breed or variety, and also to pour through a sieve. Strain is a variety and to strain is to sieve.

rounds.title: Expert pairs 18

clues: Pay for work
To carry on a war or campaign
cards.example: She earned a good ____ at the factory.
cards.explanation: Wage means pay for work, and also to carry on a war or campaign. To wage a war is to carry it on.

clues: Browned bread
To drink in honour of
cards.example: He raised his glass to ____ the bride.
cards.explanation: Toast means browned bread, and also to drink in honour of. Toast is browned bread and a drink raised in tribute.

clues: To move back and forth
A lively style of jazz
cards.example: Children love a ____ in the park.
cards.explanation: Swing means to move back and forth, and also a lively style of jazz. Swing is movement and a big-band jazz style.

clues: The pitch or quality of a sound
Firmness in a muscle
cards.example: I did not like his ____ of voice.
cards.explanation: Tone means the pitch or quality of a sound, and also firmness in a muscle. Tone is sound quality and muscular firmness.

clues: A secure room for valuables
To leap over an obstacle using the hands
cards.example: The jewels were locked in the ____.
cards.explanation: Vault means a secure room for valuables, and also to leap over an obstacle using the hands. A vault is a strongroom and a leap.
